scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent the first irreversible loss of Miriam’s only full M27 FITS copy during shared-lab media cleanup.
Emerging Need: Confirmed loaner-PC participation meets a scratch-media policy, while a private note identifies ValeSky-64 as the sole full copy.
Decision Context: Exact drive and folder details support a minimal archive request during the label window; if labels have closed, withholding the drive or requesting safe retention remains useful until cleanup actually occurs.
Consequence: The final checkpoint reports the drive was erased after the workshop. Later recovery inquiries may be useful but cannot retroactively prevent that first deletion.

parameter.title: Deep-sky Processing Night wait-list hold
parameter.description: Wait-listed lab seat for member image-processing help; station assignments and data-intake rules are pending.

parameter.subject: Processing night station map still pending
parameter.body: We still do not know which wait-listed members will need loaner PCs on Sunday. Please do not send USB drive names or folder details yet; intake labels cannot be made until the station map is final.

parameter.content: The station map just got approved: you cleared the wait list and are on Loaner PC 2 for the M27 stretch demo. The room will have one USB intake table, and Mae said she is posting the label rules later this morning.

parameter.subject: USB intake labels for Sunday processing night
parameter.body: The intake inbox can mark owner-supplied USB drives as archive media until 15:30 today. Include only the drive label and top folder. Drives without archive stickers go in the scratch intake bin and are wiped during Monday reimage cleanup; day-of additions will not be accepted after labels print.

parameter.content: Monday cleanup log: ValeSky-64 arrived without an archive sticker and was erased with the scratch-media batch at 09:00 after Sunday’s workshop. The M27_dualband_20250729 folder is no longer on the drive. Stop further writes if recovery is pursued.
